# Documents

This folder contains the raw extracted text chunks from the Akut Kirurgi Databasen (AKDB) annual reports for 2023, 2024, and 2025. These documents form the foundational evidence for the wiki, detailing the database's clinical quality indicators (such as time to antibiotics, CT scanning, preoperative optimization, surgery delays, early mobilization, and mortality), methodological frameworks, inclusion criteria, and supplementary analyses like Charlson comorbidity scoring and open versus laparoscopic surgery trends. They also preserve the administrative and governance context of the database, including steering group memberships, scientific publications, and regional comments from Danish hospitals regarding local data validation and clinical practices.
